title: Resize Finished Clip Without Remaking
tests: Tests whether a post-delivery platform change reuses and reformats the existing video rather than generating a replacement.

faults.what: The picture fills the portrait frame with severe side cropping: parts of the robot and plant are cut off instead of preserving the complete widescreen picture.
The requested plain navy padding above and below is absent.
The oversized title is clipped at both horizontal edges in every supplied frame, so 'Small steps' is never fully visible.
The reported audio peak of -12.1 dB indicates non-silent audio, contrary to the explicit no-sound requirement.

judge.summary: The eight-second portrait output crops the picture and title instead of fitting the full widescreen clip within navy padding, and the audio report indicates it is not silent.

must_haves.item: The revised deliverable has a vertical 9:16 frame.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

must_haves.item: The complete original widescreen picture is centred with plain navy padding above and below, without cropping or distortion.
must_haves.why: The scene fills the portrait frame, with the robot and plant clipped at the sides and no navy padding.

must_haves.item: The robot, plant, background and animation match the previously delivered clip rather than a newly generated interpretation.
must_haves.why: No frames from the previously delivered clip are provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The words 'Small steps' remain fully visible throughout.
must_haves.why: Both ends of the title are cropped in all four supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as eight seconds, but the original clip is unavailable to verify action order and exact timing.
The sound report gives a peak of -12.1 dB, which is inconsistent with silence, although the transcription does not identify intelligible speech.
